meta.name: buzz-recon
meta.description: PR and community reconnaissance — audit current press coverage, social presence, community health, and competitor PR. Use when asked to "audit our PR", "what's our community state", "how do we compare in press", or before planning a launch or community initiative.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计公关与社区状况，辅助发布决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需快速了解品牌公关与社区健康度
copy.tagline_en: Audit PR and community health to inform launch decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly assess brand PR and community health

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演 PR 与社区工程师，自动搜索项目文件中的社区平台、社交媒体和媒体引用，然后诊断 PR 阶段、盘点媒体报道、审计社区健康状况、分析竞争对手 PR 表现，最后输出一份评估报告。
howto.when: 当你要求“审计我们的 PR”、“查看社区状态”、“比较媒体表现”，或在计划产品发布或社区活动之前。

say.note: Claude 会搜索媒体提及并评估 PR 阶段。

say.text: 检查我们的社区健康状态
say.note: Claude 会审计各社区平台活跃度和响应时间。

say.text: 比较我们在媒体中的表现
say.note: Claude 会搜索竞争对手的 PR 活动并进行对比。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as Buzz, the PR & community engineer, automatically scanning project files for community platforms, social media, and press references, then diagnosing PR stage, inventorying coverage, auditing community health, analyzing competitor PR, and outputting an assessment report.
howto.when_en: When asked to "audit our PR", "what's our community state", "how do we compare in press", or before planning a launch or community initiative.

say_en.note: Claude will search for press mentions and assess PR stage.
Claude will audit activity and response times across platforms.
Claude will search competitor PR activities for comparison.
